milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The acacia sign is placed at spawn-relative (3, 1, 3). The player must navigate near it and face it to 'find' it. max_distance=5 ensures the player is close enough to read the sign text, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures they are looking toward it.

Uses inventory_has because mining an emerald block with a diamond pickaxe drops 1 emerald_block item into the player's inventory. The player starts with no emerald_block items, so having at least 1 confirms the block was successfully mined. This is preferred over spatial checks per the 'mine tasks → inventory_has' mapping.

Uses inventory_has because trading with the armorer villager for iron leggings results in the item appearing in the player's inventory. The player starts with no iron leggings, so having at least 1 confirms a successful trade was completed. The player must first craft the emerald_block into 9 emeralds at the nearby crafting table, then trade 7 emeralds with the armorer.
